candidate_property_update.property: Independent positive diagonal affine equivariance at anchor and hit
candidate_property_update.transform: V'_r = V_r Gamma_r + 1 b_r^T, r in {a,s}; Gamma_a and Gamma_s may differ and are positive diagonal.
candidate_property_update.assumptions: Q/K, support, groups and P fixed under each coordinate change; Q/K may differ between anchor and hit. Use channel-normalized features ((G-B)D_s^+)Pv, inactive scale floor, and theoretical zero-variance branch.
candidate_property_update.consequence: C_a, C_s-C_a, Psi, fitted ridge coefficients and K are invariant; full output transforms as Ahat'_s=Ahat_s Gamma_s+1b_s^T, including exact P overwrite. This allows nonzero routing innovation.
candidate_property_update.evidence_scope: Two independent float64 CPU mathematical-semantics verifications, not real-model quality or GPU speed evidence. The exact classes E_s=E_a and C_s=C_a differ; no universal superset claim.

search_scope_and_limits.novelty_conclusion: A concrete composite method and a sharper defect-transport mechanism are defined. The nearest verified predecessors already provide individual centroid compensation, full-defect reuse, P64 ridge repair and empirical interpolation. The scoped candidate distinction is input-V-equivariant transport plus observed innovation update. This review does not establish a global first-priority claim.
